summary: Accepted ADR dated 2026-07-05 that supersedes ADR-007's deferral of chat-surface renderer choice while carrying forward and hardening the engine rule. Context: the codebase is primarily AI-authored and 2025 evidence shows XSS is the dominant AI failure class, with models most fluent in React; auto-escaping closes that class structurally. Roadmap chat and agent surfaces plus agent-context plans require serializable UI state; closure-held vanilla DOM is agent-opaque while store-driven React matches comparable production apps. Decision: UI layer is React 19 plus TSX transpiled natively by Bun with no Vite or Next, bundled into the same single exe; Zustand for shell store plus one store per app; no URL router; CSS Modules over tokens with no Tailwind; whole UI converts to one idiom; app contract v2 is React component export plus manifest including agentSurface descriptor; engine rule forbids renderer imports in converter canonical model engines and star-core files; react react-dom zustand join vetted set with further deps commit-declared; dangerouslySetInnerHTML and raw HTML sinks banned outside allowlist. Consequences: rewrite bounded by pure cores as spec; XSS closed by default; agent fluency; framework churn risk accepted with engine immune.

sections.title: Context
sections.summary: Two constraints crystallized after ADR-007. The codebase is primarily AI-authored vibecoded, and 2025 evidence shows XSS is the dominant AI failure class at roughly 86 percent of relevant samples failing XSS defenses at 2.74 times the human rate, while models are most fluent in React; an auto-escaping renderer closes that class structurally. Roadmap chat and agent surfaces M4 Table Read packages agent and Studio plus per-surface agent-context plans require UI state to be serializable data an agent can read and act through; closure-held vanilla DOM state is agent-opaque while store-driven React is the pattern comparable production apps ship.

sections.title: Decision
sections.summary: UI layer is React 19 plus TSX transpiled natively by Bun without Vite or Next and bundled into the same single exe. State is Zustand with one shell store plus one store per app surface; navigation is state-driven with no URL router. Styling is CSS Modules over the existing token system with no Tailwind. The UI converts whole shell and every app folder to one idiom; until conversion lands, vanilla surfaces remain the behavioral spec. App contract v2 is a React component export plus manifest including an agentSurface descriptor of state selector and offered actions so every surface is agent-readable by construction. Engine rule unchanged and hardened: converter, canonical model, engines, and every star-core.ts stay pure framework-less TS; a renderer import there is a guardrail violation. Dependency posture adds react react-dom zustand to the vetted set; further dependencies must be declared in the commit message and are mechanically gated. dangerouslySetInnerHTML and raw HTML-injection sinks are banned by repo gates outside an explicit sanctioned allowlist.

sections.title: Consequences
sections.summary: Editor slice 1 and the current shell are rebuilt in React during conversion; their behavior and pure tested cores are the spec so the rewrite is bounded. The XSS class is closed by default rendering behavior; gates enforce the escape-hatch ban and the dependency ledger. Agent fluency and OSS contributor familiarity align with the codebase authoring mode. Framework-churn risk of React major versions is accepted and bounded: the engine layer is immune and surfaces are isolated per app folder.
